name: Kyrgyzstan

flag.description: A red field with a yellow sun of 40 straight rays in the centre; inside the sun is a red ring crossed by two sets of three lines, depicting the crown (tunduk) of a yurt.
flag.symbolism: The 40 rays represent the 40 tribes united by the epic hero Manas, and the tunduk symbolises home, family and the unity of the people; red is said to recall Manas's banner.

hook: Kyrgyzstan is a yellow sun with 40 rays on red, its centre crossed like the roof lattice of a yurt; North Macedonia's sun has just eight broad rays.
trivia: In 2023 the rays were redrawn as straight lines instead of wavy flames, partly because the old design was said to look like a sunflower.
The Epic of Manas, the source of the flag's 40 rays, is one of the longest epic poems in the world.
